title: [3.3.0-dev-e] Fallback to profile sensitivity notification
body: Hi, i recently built the new dev version (6201b8050c-2024.12.02), imported my historic data from NS (making historic TDD available). Once a day i receive the notification that there is not enough TDD data and it falls back to profile sensitivity ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b96233b-676e-4e4f-b475-e05aac2dcf7e) TDD is available: ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5842b9da-177a-42d8-b80f-f1669d79241a) ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/42bd5c11-ad22-4a88-8929-1ddd585136e4) In discord i briefly announced this, where it was a known issue using the AutoISF plugin. I am using the SMB plugin. comments.body:
In your case the reason is that data is comming delayed from xdrip ie.
16:47:15 AAPS received BG with timestamp 16:42:03
There is nothing I can do with this
I improved the messaage in dev

Thanks! looking at your explanation it's likely that data is being backfilled by xdrip because of a missed bg due to out-of-range sensor on the previous BG, which can happen on various occasions. It would be a nice improvement if the notification can be suppressed or not being shown in this instance.
